scope: Explain saved HYDRA versus NWM errors at Jefferson and Galax; descriptive post-assessment analysis, not model selection
threshold_population: Previously frozen final-development unique approved gradient-calendar hours, independent of forecast admission
event_selection: Rank all approved exact-hour Q>frozen gradient q95 by descending discharge and earliest UTC ties; greedily retain peaks at least168h apart; first3 per gauge
event_windows: Half-open; clipped to full verification-reference calendar; retain clipped/gapped/unavailable events without replacement
event_independence: Diagnostic separated episodes, not proven physically independent floods
quality: Unchanged approved A/A+R; retain original masks and qualifiers; never impute targets or infer missing peaks
comparison: Existing strict all18-target primary origin cohort intersected with genuine exact C-2 NWM availability at each H1-16 lead
hydrograph_interpretation: Fixed-lead forecasts from successive origins C=t-h, not one issued trajectory; full known observations shown independently of forecast availability
seed_display: All3 seed curves or mean plus min/max display; metric means are means of individual-seed metrics, not ensemble skill; no confidence intervals
event_metrics: error and ratio at observed peak
fixed-lead rolling-trace peak amplitude and timing
peak_metric_distinction: Prediction at observed peak is distinct from maximum of fixed-lead forecast trace; timing diagnostics require observed-peak support and report finite/common window coverage
annual_gap_decomposition: Mean over16leads and3seeds of (HYDRA SSE-NWM SSE)/same annual observed SST, partitioned into nonoverlapping top3 valid-time windows plus all remaining matched cells; signed contributions exactly reconcile the annual NSE gap
decomposition_interpretation: Accounting concentration, not causal attribution or a counterfactual forecast improvement; shares may be negative or exceed100%
issuance_context: At each observed peak/lead report actual latest history Q at peak-h-2h; this is an input diagnostic, not a persistence baseline
saved_parameter_diagnostic: Read-only exact hash-verified saved best weights: analytically derive LayerNorm-to-linear global output envelope and saved affine physical-Q inverse; no model construction or forward
output_bound_caveat: Exact-real structural envelope with separately reported floating-point comparison tolerance; not a machine-certified FP32 bound or proof of training-distribution maximum
architecture_proposals: iTransformer and iTransformer-encoder/GRU-decoder are future development hypotheses; assessment outcomes cannot be reused as an untouched selection set
